instruction: Create a marketing campaign targeting Class 11 students for MeetUniversity Aspirations with audience research, creative concepts, and a 30-day content calendar.

tasks.title: Parallel: Class 11 Student & Parent Audience Pain-Point Research
tasks.description: Identify academic stream anxiety, career confusion, and decision triggers for Class 11 students in India.

payload.query: Class 11 student career confusion stream selection India EdTech

### Class 11 Audience Research — MeetUniversity Aspirations

> **Active Memory Constraints Applied:** - **Remembered:** Always highlight Hyderabad and Bangalore regional hubs. | - **Remembered:** Completed run 'run_a2ba21a9' for instruction: Send email outreach to principal@dps-partner.example.com for MeetUniversity Aspirations. | - **Remembered:** Completed run 'run_26742ba6' for instruction: Send email outreach to principal@dps-partner.example.com for MeetUniversity Aspirations.

- **Primary Concerns:** Stream lock-in regret (Science vs. Commerce vs. Humanities), parental pressure around JEE/NEET vs. emerging careers, and lack of clarity on global undergraduate prerequisites.
- **Decision Makers:** Dual-audience funnel — Students discover via Instagram Reels/YouTube Shorts; Parents validate via WhatsApp brochures and School Principal webinars.

### Campaign Strategy & Creative Concepts (`Aspirations — Future-Proof Class 11`)

> **Active Memory Constraints Applied:** - **Remembered:** Always highlight Hyderabad and Bangalore regional hubs. | - **Remembered:** Completed run 'run_a2ba21a9' for instruction: Send email outreach to principal@dps-partner.example.com for MeetUniversity Aspirations. | - **Remembered:** Completed run 'run_26742ba6' for instruction: Send email outreach to principal@dps-partner.example.com for MeetUniversity Aspirations.

- **Core Positioning:** *'Don't guess your next 10 years in Class 11. Test-drive careers before choosing your path.'*
- **Concept 1 (Interactive Hook):** *The 7-Minute Career Blindspot Quiz* — reveals top 3 aligned careers + subject combinations.
- **Concept 2 (Parent Trust):** *Beyond Engineering & Medicine: 2026 Global Career Map* live webinar with university admissions mentors.

tasks.title: 30-Day Multi-Channel Content Calendar & Sample Assets
tasks.description: Build a 30-day Instagram/YouTube/WhatsApp/School-Webinar calendar and draft sample email/social copy.
tasks.output:
# MeetUniversity Aspirations — Class 11 Go-To-Market Campaign & 30-Day Calendar

> **Active Memory Constraints Applied:** - **Remembered:** Always highlight Hyderabad and Bangalore regional hubs. | - **Remembered:** Completed run 'run_a2ba21a9' for instruction: Send email outreach to principal@dps-partner.example.com for MeetUniversity Aspirations. | - **Remembered:** Completed run 'run_26742ba6' for instruction: Send email outreach to principal@dps-partner.example.com for MeetUniversity Aspirations.

## 1. Strategic Overview
Target 10,000+ Class 11 students and 2,500 parents across Tier-1 and Tier-2 CBSE/ICSE schools through a 4-week hook-educate-convert sprint.

## 2. 30-Day Multi-Channel Content Calendar
| Days | Theme | Channel | Deliverable / Hook | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days 1–7 | **Awareness: Stream Myth-Busting** | Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts | 5 short videos debunking 'Only Science pays' with real salary data | Take Free Aspirations Diagnostic |
| Days 8–14 | **Discovery: Career Blindspot Challenge** | Instagram Carousel + School WhatsApp | Interactive career-aptitude quiz & downloadable Subject Roadmap PDF | Book 1:1 Mentor Review |
| Days 15–21 | **Parent Alignment Week** | Live Webinar + Email Drip | *'Class 11 Parent Blueprint: India vs. Global UG Admissions'* | Register Parent + Student Seat |
| Days 22–30 | **Conversion & School Cohorts** | WhatsApp + Principal Outreach | Case studies of Class 11 alumni + limited cohort enrollment offer | Enroll in Aspirations Cohort |

## 3. Sample Campaign Assets
- **Instagram Hook:** *'Picked PCM/Commerce in Class 11 because your friends did? Here are 4 high-growth careers you can still unlock—before boards hit.'*
- **Parent Email Subject:** *Your child's Class 11 subject choices shape 2030 admissions — 15-min Career Clarity Checklist inside.*
